_comment: Roughly where each loot tier sits on Chernarus, as world coordinates in metres.
Tiers are a property of the economy the server runs, not of any map picture: a building
group's tier decides which entries in types.xml can spawn in it. What is drawn here is a
coarse, hand-written approximation of the vanilla arrangement - coast low, inland higher,
the north-west military sites highest - meant for orientation, not for auditing an economy.
The boundaries below are deliberately smooth and are nobody's survey of the real ones.
Each area is a polygon; the four tile the map, so edit one edge and the neighbour keeps up
only if you edit its matching vertices too. labelAt places the name where the shape is
widest, because a centroid lands badly on a shape this long.
